note: People inside rooms (roadmap item 41; core/game/game_people.gd, checked by tools/check_data.gd). Each service interior (GameSpaces layouts: forge, temple, store, tavern, board, black_market) has one person standing at a fixed cell `at` of its entrance room (a cell of the interior's own floor, x east and z south from the door). The person is a solid cell (GameInterior marks it `person`) and the heir talks to them by standing on a floor cell beside it and using it: a line of greeting, and in the town where the family is the service opens (`open`: shop, workshop, tavern or board; `tab` the shop's tab). Away from that town the person only talks. Nothing here is random or saved, and the autopilot never walks in. The shop keepers of data/shops/shops.json stand in the entrance room of their shop by day (`GameShops.open_at`); at night the shop is shut and the person is gone.

people.name: Brann the smith
people.greet: Brann looks up from the anvil. "Metal or mending?"

people.name: Sister Ione
people.greet: Sister Ione folds her hands. "The temple is open to the weary."

people.name: Odo the storekeeper
people.greet: Odo wipes the counter. "Anything caught your eye?"

people.name: Marta the host
people.greet: Marta sets down a mug. "Sit, and tell me your news."

people.name: Pell the clerk
people.greet: Pell taps the notices. "Work for willing hands."

people.name: A hooded fence
people.greet: The fence says nothing, then, low: "Quiet prices. Quiet deals."

people.name: Wenna the baker
people.greet: Wenna dusts off her hands. "Fresh from the oven, if you hurry."

people.name: Tobin the greengrocer
people.greet: Tobin turns an apple in his fingers. "What is in season is in season."

people.name: Garrick the butcher
people.greet: Garrick wipes his cleaver. "Hung three days and not a day less."

people.name: Sela the fishmonger
people.greet: Sela sluices the slab. "Ask me what came in with the tide."

people.name: Maud the dairymaid
people.greet: Maud skims the pail. "Still warm, if you are not dawdling."

people.name: Old Hester
people.greet: Hester sniffs. "You have a look of someone who ought to be drinking something."

people.name: Master Lorne
people.greet: Lorne peers over his spectacles. "Describe the symptoms. Slowly."

people.name: Fenwick the alchemist
people.greet: Fenwick looks up, singed. "Do not touch the green one. Or the blue one."

people.name: Hild the armourer
people.greet: Hild taps a breastplate. "Stand still. I measure once."

people.name: Aldric the bowyer
people.greet: Aldric runs a thumb down the limb. "Draw it. Slowly. Feel her answer."

people.name: Marit the tailor
people.greet: Marit pins a hem. "Hold still. Lift your arm. No, the other one."

people.name: Piet the cobbler
people.greet: Piet taps a sole with his hammer. "Boots are a promise to your feet."

people.name: Brisa the tanner
people.greet: Brisa wrinkles her nose, from habit. "You get used to the smell. Mostly."

people.name: Garth the stablemaster
people.greet: Garth strokes a nose. "She would carry a family, if the family would stop arguing."

people.name: Hob the drover
people.greet: Hob leans on the rail. "Pick any that will pick you."

people.name: Rurik the huntsman
people.greet: Rurik rubs his beard. "Anything bigger than a wolf, bring a friend."

people.name: Sir Aurel, jeweller
people.greet: Aurel screws a loupe into his eye. "Tell me what you have. Do not tell me what it is worth."

people.name: Brokk the gem-cutter
people.greet: Brokk holds a stone to the light. "Rough. Honest. Give me a day and she will sing."

people.name: Ysolde the scribe
people.greet: Ysolde blots a page. "Letters, deeds, love notes. All in the same hand."

people.name: Cecily the bookseller
people.greet: Cecily does not look up. "Please do not read the books without buying them."

people.name: Zephyra the scrollwright
people.greet: Zephyra smiles thinly. "Everything is a spell if you read it aloud."

people.name: Orsolya the enchanter
people.greet: Orsolya turns a ring. "Everything is already enchanted. I just ask nicely."

people.name: Pellam the cartographer
people.greet: Pellam unrolls a chart. "Here be roads. Here be, regrettably, dragons."

people.name: Bryn the chandler
people.greet: Bryn trims a wick. "A good light costs little. A dark night costs more."

people.name: Dorrin the potter
people.greet: Dorrin looks up, floury with clay. "It will hold water. Eventually."

people.name: Ilvane the glassblower
people.greet: Ilvane gathers a molten glob. "Stand clear. Breathing near it is bad luck."

people.name: Osric the carpenter
people.greet: Osric sights along a plank. "Straight as the day is long."

people.name: Thora the mason
people.greet: Thora raps a block with her knuckle. "Hear that? That is a good note."

people.name: Edda the miller
people.greet: Edda brushes flour from her sleeves. "Bring me wheat and I will bring you bread."

people.name: Durgan the smelter
people.greet: Durgan roars over the furnace. "Ore in, iron out. That is the whole art!"

people.name: Captain Marn
people.greet: Marn lifts a coil of rope. "The sea does not care. The rope must."

people.name: Pippa the gardener
people.greet: Pippa pats the soil. "Everything wants to grow. Mostly it wants to be left alone."

people.name: Ned the barber
people.greet: Ned waves a razor. "A little off the top? Or the leg?"

people.name: Mirela the bath-keeper
people.greet: Mirela hums over the kettle. "The water is hot. The gossip is hotter."

people.name: Hrodgar the brewer
people.greet: Hrodgar wipes foam from his beard. "Taste before you pay. Pay after you taste."

people.name: Lady Isaura, banker
people.greet: Isaura steeples her fingers. "Everything has its price. Let us find yours."

people.name: Slim the pawnbroker
people.greet: Slim eyes you over his spectacles. "Everything is worth something. Not much, mind."

people.name: Guildmaster Torv
people.greet: Torv slaps the bench. "Sign the book, or buy a round. Either way."

people.name: Sergeant Cael
people.greet: Cael does not salute. "State your business. Briefly."

people.name: Brother Harn
people.greet: Brother Harn bows his head. "The hearth is warm for any who come in good faith."

text.only_talk: {name} has nothing for you here: the family is not in this town.
text.nobody: There is nobody here to talk to.
text.shut: {name} is not here: {shop} is shut, and opens at {open}.
